RecommendWorkNow.title: Work Now
RecommendWorkNow.summary: Your profile is ready enough to begin targeting entry-level opportunities.
next_steps: Adjust your CV to the selected career goal
Compare your profile with the requirements of the selected opportunity
Submit applications to relevant entry-level roles
RecommendWorkNow.limitation_note: This recommendation indicates readiness to start applying and does not guarantee acceptance.

RecommendWorkPreparation.title: Internship or Skill Preparation
RecommendWorkPreparation.summary: You need a focused preparation step before pursuing the main work opportunity.

next_steps: Identify the core skill missing from the target opportunity
Complete one beginner learning resource for that skill
Create one small project that demonstrates the skill
Prepare a CV that highlights relevant skills and projects
Improve or create one portfolio project
Apply to internships, traineeships, or suitable entry-level opportunities

RecommendWorkPreparation.limitation_note: The system distinguishes project evidence from professional experience.

RecommendMastersPreparation.title: Master's Preparation
RecommendMastersPreparation.summary: Your current preference supports preparing for a master's degree path.
next_steps: Shortlist programs that match the selected field
Check academic, language, and document requirements
Prepare the required documents and application schedule
RecommendMastersPreparation.limitation_note: Program-specific eligibility must still be checked against official requirements.

RecommendScholarshipPreparation.title: Scholarship Preparation
RecommendScholarshipPreparation.summary: Your study goal requires a funding path, so scholarship preparation is prioritized.
next_steps: Shortlist scholarships that support the selected study goal
Check academic, language, and document requirements
Prepare evidence, essays, and recommendation documents
RecommendScholarshipPreparation.limitation_note: This recommendation does not estimate the probability of receiving a scholarship.

RecommendCareerExploration.title: Career Exploration
RecommendCareerExploration.summary: Your career direction needs to be clarified before selecting a specific opportunity path.
next_steps: Choose two fields that currently interest you
Try one small introductory project or learning activity in each field
Compare the activities and select a goal for the next assessment
RecommendCareerExploration.limitation_note: The system needs a clearer goal before it can provide a specific opportunity recommendation.

supporting_actions.RecommendStudyAsParallelPlan: Keep further-study preparation as a parallel plan while prioritizing near-term income.
supporting_actions.RecommendPortfolioImprovement: Improve the existing project and align its description with the target opportunity.
